detail_product.description: A product in a get_product response, extended with effective selections and availability signals on option values.

options.description: Product options with availability signals relative to the effective selections.

selected.description: Effective option selections that anchor the featured variant and availability signals. Required when the product has configurable options; may be empty or omitted for products with no option axes.

get_product_request.description: Request body for single-product retrieval. Supports interactive variant narrowing via selected and preferences.

filters.description: Filter criteria to narrow returned variants. All specified filters combine with AND logic.

id.description: Product or variant identifier. Implementations MUST support product ID and variant ID.

preferences.description: Option names in relaxation priority order. When no exact variant matches all selections, the server drops options from the end of this list first. E.g., ['Color', 'Size'] keeps Color and relaxes Size.

selected.description: Partial or full option selections for interactive variant narrowing. When provided, response option values include availability signals (available, exists) relative to these selections.

actions.description: Outstanding extension-defined Actions for this product response.

messages.description: Warnings or informational messages about the product (e.g., price recently changed, limited availability).

policies.description: Policies (e.g., return/refund terms) that apply to this product. `applies_to` targets are relative to the response root; when absent or empty, refer to the URLs in `links[]`.

product.description: The requested product with full detail. Singular — this is a single-resource operation.

filters.description: Filter criteria to narrow returned products and variants. All specified filters combine with AND logic.

ids.description: Identifiers to lookup. Implementations MUST support product ID and variant ID; MAY support secondary identifiers (SKU, handle, etc.).

actions.description: Outstanding extension-defined Actions for this catalog lookup response.

messages.description: Errors, warnings, or informational messages about the requested items.

policies.description: Policies (e.g., return/refund terms) that apply to the products in this response. `applies_to` targets are relative to the response root; when absent or empty, refer to the URLs in `links[]`.

products.description: Products matching the requested identifiers. May contain fewer items if some identifiers not found, or more if identifiers match multiple products.

lookup_variant.description: Variant with required correlation metadata for lookup responses.

inputs.description: Which request identifiers resolved to this variant, and how. Each entry maps a request ID to its match type.

description: Product/variant lookup by identifier. Supports batch retrieval (lookup_catalog) and single-product detail (get_product).
name: dev.ucp.shopping.catalog.lookup
title: Catalog Lookup
